title: Check Your Work Permit Status in the UAE 2026
description: Waiting for your UAE work permit status? Learn how to track your application status via MOHRE and Free Zone portals in minutes.

contentHtml:
Your work permit is the only document hindering you from collecting your first paycheck in the UAE. A few individuals know what a work permit is until an unexpected event occurs. Managing a legitimate job and active residence requires frequent verification and a UAE work permit status check.

The formal website or mobile application of MOHRE is the best source to confirm your work permit status. You can quickly identify the status of your request by typing in your passport number or transactional reference. By adopting a proactive mindset, you could prevent unforeseen consequences and penalties. It allows you to keep moving forward in your career in the Emirates.

Work Permit Status in the UAE Matters More

If you intend to maintain your legal status and financial stability, you must know your work permit application status in the UAE. Any professional activity in the UAE must have a valid work permit complying with Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.

You should face serious repercussions if you work without this permission. You risk hefty fines for overstaying and a ban on Emirates identification. Also, face major setbacks in dependents’ sponsorship if you ignore your UAE work permit status. 

Additionally, the Wages Protection System correlates this document to your paycheck. So, if your permit is invalid, your payment will be completely withheld. Getting legal employment in the UAE should be your top priority if you’re seeking a smooth career journey.

Verify UAE Work Permit Status with Formal Methods

Work Permit Inquiry Online Platform

To check UAE work permit status online, the best resource is the authorized MOHRE website. Pick “Digital Work Permit Details” from the list of inquiry services.

Simply provide your nationality, date of birth, passport information, application number, or person code for a work permit inquiry. To provide complete transparency, this platform gives you live updates of your permit status. Regardless of its acceptance, pending, or processing phase.

Government Accreditation and Off-Site Locations

You may reach the MOHRE toll-free number for UAE work permit status check if you would prefer offline support or have internet issues. You may also check your data in a more official setting by visiting an approved Tasheel or service center.

When dealing with complex inquiries or updating records manually, these support centers are still an excellent resource to have on hand.

Work Permit Smartphone Application

Install the MOHRE UAE mobile application for a more convenient way to check your UAE work permit status while on the go. Go to the worker’s dashboard once you’ve logged in, using your UAE Pass for safe login for the MOHRE work permit inquiry.

This mobile application has several useful features, such as an online labor card, an application status monitor, and a registered job agreement PDF download. Workers may easily track their legal status using this application wherever they are.

Expected Timeframe for Work Permit Process in 2025–2026

With a preliminary MOHRE processing time 2025 and 2026 of three to seven business days, it is still quite effective. Two to four weeks is the typical duration for a standard hire, beginning with the entry permit and ending with the residency.

However, the UAE work permit processing time has been minimized due to electronic integration across government systems. They can still be extended by twenty-one days due to employers’ non-compliance or missing paperwork.

What Do You Expect After Approval? Seamless UAE Work Permit Authorization

You will need the entry permit from your company after the UAE work permit approval. It starts the formal procedure for joining the local workforce, whether it’s for legal entrance or a modification of status.

A health assessment and biometric information are essential to complete the Emirates ID process in the UAE. For all formal government services, this card is the primary type of identification.

A digital record connected to your identification. Now it serves as a residency visa after a work permit. Your right to live and work in the nation is finally confirmed with this last step.

Understanding Your Permit Status Code

It is critical to understand certain codes to prevent delays while tracking the progress of your MOHRE application status. Look for missing qualifications or a mismatch in your profession. 

Typical conditions for UAE work permits include the following:

  • The ministry is presently reviewing your case, under process status, indicating that there is no need to take any action at this time.
  • You are legitimately cleared for employment if your status is approved. Your labor card is being issued.
  • If you get the status, your UAE work permit is rejected. Find out why it was rejected and then resubmit with revised details. 
  • If the status shows that your UAE work permit is pending employer action. It indicates that your company is required to pay the service costs or submit the executed contract urgently due to pending employer action. 
  • If your status shows more details needed, you will need to provide further certifications or a justification. It is crucial to fulfill the government’s pre-set standards.
  • Your employer has revoked your status if it is withdrawn. You need to explain the present scenario.

FAQs

Where should I check the present status of my UAE work permit?

Go to the MOHRE site or install the mobile app. To access the MOHRE enquiry FAQ, use the inquiry services section. You need to enter your passport or transaction number.

What is the term “Pending Employer Action” on the MOHRE site?

It implies that the authority is patiently awaiting a step to be finished. Your company needs to pay the outstanding salaries or upload the finalized job agreement.

How can I verify my UAE work permit status?

For a Dubai visa, use either the GDRFA site or the ICP Smart Services platform. You may easily monitor your status by providing your passport number and expiration date.

Should I use my passport number to verify the validity of the UAE work permit?

The MOHRE site really lets you check your status by entering your passport number. To begin your search, select an online info service for the UAE work permit check passport number.

What is the typical processing time for a UAE work permit in 2026?

Three to seven business days is the typical time it takes to issue a permit. Most UAE companies experienced a tremendous speed in these time frames due to the digital shift.

What should I do if my work permit is denied?

Use the MOHRE site to find out the exact reason for the refusal. Request your employer to resubmit once you fix the mistakes in the paperwork or the passport authenticity.

Should I start working if my work permit request is in process?

The formal approval of your work permit is needed before you start working legally. Heavy penalties and bans may result from working during the application procedure.

Is a work permit still necessary for Golden Visa holders to work in the UAE?

It is true, it is necessary to work in the country. However, Golden Visa holders need a special work authorization because MOHRE needs their professional information on file.

What is the cost of the UAE work permit?

About 3,500 to 7,500 AED is the average price range. Your profession, the job type, and your recruitment location will decide the ultimate pricing.

What is the Work Bundle in the UAE, and how may it impact my application?

All of your work visas, work permits, and Emirates IDs can be found in one convenient online system called the Work Bundle. It accelerates the application process by synchronizing data across multiple government entities.
